note: Turn 9 — belief, framed the way a secular family would frame it.

nextQuestion.text: Is there anything else you would want people to hear about her?

extractedFacts.text: Not religious; believed in turning up

chapterUpserts.summary: Her answer to almost everything was "Well, we’ll see" — which the family understood to mean anything from yes to absolutely not. She was not religious. What she believed in was showing up: funerals, hospital visits, the first day of school.

anecdoteAdds.text: She was not a churchgoer. What she believed in was showing up — funerals, hospital visits, the first day of school. She was always the one already there when you arrived.
